picks.why: Beat low expectations: revenue $188.6M vs about $164M expected, EPS $0.13 vs $0.05. Volume was 5.3M shares vs a 772K average, and it ran as much as 50% at the high.
picks.risk: Easy comparison against a weak year-ago quarter. The platform segment is only growing single digits, so a gap this big can fade fast.

picks.why: Daily users +29% to 64.9M (up from +23% last quarter). Revenue +14% to $309M and the full-year forecast was raised. It traded $157.00 to $175.56 on the day.
picks.risk: Subscriber growth (+14%) lags user growth, and the AI-disruption worry was eased, not removed.

picks.why: Revenue $19.95B vs $16.39B expected and EPS $1.81 vs $1.23. Full-year outlook raised to $72B-$82B. The stock had fallen 28% in the month before. Options implied volatility was about 167%.
picks.risk: Margin guidance is thin (10.4%-10.8%) and a board governance review is still pending.

picks.why: Agreed to buy Lumentum in an all-stock deal valued at $115B and fell about 13% before the open, then recovered to close up 0.33%. Volume was about 67% above its 3-month average.
picks.risk: All-stock deal means dilution, and TD Cowen cut it to Hold. A flush that recovers can still roll over.

picks.why: Fell sharply after the midterm results and is on this week's earnings list.
picks.risk: The source gives two different drops (about 17% in the text, about 24.5% in its list), so check the live price before trusting any number here.

picks.why: Trades near a third of its high. 5.8 GW power pipeline, with 500 MW planned online in 2027 to reach 800 MW. Talks for 2027 and 2028 capacity.
picks.risk: The writer owns shares and calls. Earnings can gap it either way.

picks.why: About 38% below its post-IPO high. Ron Baron, whose largest holding is SpaceX, interviews Elon Musk on Nov 6. Topics could be Starlink Mobile, AI, orbital computing.
picks.risk: Event hype is mixed: Tesla fell after Baron's 2022 event and rose about 6.5% after 2023.

picks.why: Down about 36% from its high and off 6% on the day. Memory supply is tight and gross margin is 80.7%. Analysts expect 107% growth this fiscal year.
picks.risk: Memory is cyclical and the stock has swung from $192 to $1,255 in a year. The writer owns shares.

picks.why: The FDA accepted the filing for ivonescimab (EGFR-mutated lung cancer, with chemo) and set a Nov 14, 2026 decision date.
picks.risk: Binary event: the FDA can approve, delay, ask for more data or call an advisory panel. The source is from April, so check current news and price first.

picks.why: Q3 revenue $2.31B vs $2.17B expected, EPS $0.44 vs $0.40, and the full-year outlook was raised to about $8.53B. The stock still slipped about 2.3%.
picks.risk: Around 261x trailing earnings before the report. A beat that does not lift the stock can mean the good news is already priced in. Source figures conflict in places.

picks.why: Q2 revenue +106% with a 74.7% gross margin and about 70% growth guided for next year. About 13.5x next year's earnings.
picks.risk: Has lagged this year. A big chunk of the thesis is 2027 estimates coming true. The writer owns shares.

picks.why: Analyst target raised from $350 to $400. AI revenue is expected to double to $115B in fiscal 2027 and $230B in 2028. Anthropic has $161B of commitments with it.
picks.risk: Growth leans on Anthropic and OpenAI, who depend on raising more money. The writer owns shares.

picks.why: About 5.3x this year's earnings, 80.7% gross margin and 107% expected growth. The CEO reportedly expects supply to stay tight through 2027 and 2028.
picks.risk: Memory booms end. Customer supply agreements may soften the next downturn but will not remove it.

picks.why: Google Cloud grew 103% in Q3. The stock fell more than 10% after earnings, then bounced with the broad market.
picks.risk: Heavy AI spending is pushing cash flow negative. The writer owns shares.

picks.why: Q2 revenue +454% vs costs +251%. Contract value quadrupled from last quarter. Prepayments fund 50-60% of build-out and a $3.5B Citi facility closed in October.
picks.risk: Down about 42% in a month and still unprofitable.

picks.why: $104.2B backlog (3x last year). Q2 revenue more than doubled to $2.6B and operating margin nearly turned positive. 1.5 GW live, about 4.2 GW contracted.
picks.risk: Current ratio 0.46 and debt coming due. The writer's least favorite of three neoclouds.
